questions.question: How long have you been in your city?
questions.translation: منذ متى وأنت تعيش في مدينتك؟
suggested_answers: I have been in my city for ten years.
I have lived in my city since I was born.
I have been in my city for five years, since we moved here.

questions.question: What do you enjoy doing?
suggested_answers: I enjoy reading books and playing football in my free time.
I like listening to music and playing games with my friends.
I enjoy doing sports and reading stories because they are fun.

questions.question: What do you do to help elderly people?
suggested_answers: I help elderly people carry their bags and cross the street.
I visit old people and talk with them to make them happy.
I help elderly people by carrying things for them and supporting them.

questions.question: Who helps you with your homework?
suggested_answers: My mother helps me with my homework.
My father and my brother help me with my homework.
My teacher helps me with my homework when I don't understand.
